channel.title: The Kara-Buura garden
channel.description: notes that grow slowly, about a valley I left and keep going back to

item.title: Going back in August
item.description: [photo: field | The road into the valley, August 2026.] Every August I go home for two weeks. The tree had a heavy year. Granny made jam in the same basin as in 1990. My aunt, retired now, still prints her lessons for an old man in Nurzhan who has no Tulpar and sends them by post. I sat with…

item.title: Kyzyl-Adyr place names
item.description: Collecting the names people use for places in town that are on no map: "the hot pipe" (where the heating main crosses the ditch and the snow never stays), "the Bulgarian" (a shop, no idea why), "the old cinema" (it was never a cinema). More to come.

item.title: Water turns
item.description: In summer the irrigation ditch comes to our street on a schedule: each yard gets the water for a set number of hours, by turn, day or night. The man who keeps the turns is called the mirab. When our turn fell at 3 a.m., Grandfather went out with a shovel and a torch, and so did every neighbour on…

item.title: The frost of 2008
item.description: Granny says the spring frost of 2008 "killed the flowers in one night" and there were no apricots in the whole district that year. I can't find it written anywhere. Anyone from the Kara-Buura who remembers, write to me.

item.title: My aunt's blog
item.description: My aunt Saltanat Kubanychbekovna taught history at School No. 1 for thirty years and kept a blog on Kündölük from 2006 to 2019. I made its colours when I was 15. She thanked me for them in her last post and I didn't read that post until 2022. Her lesson notes are better than any textbook on our…

item.title: Grafting, as my grandfather did it
item.description: Grandfather grafted in April, with a knife he sharpened on the doorstep and tape from an old cassette. Cleft graft, two scions per branch "in case one is lazy". Half the trees in the yard are his grafts on wild stock from the hills. Still to write: which variety came from where. Granny remembers;…

item.title: On apricots and patience
item.description: [photo: apricots | Granny's tree, July 2023.] Granny's tree in the yard in Kyzyl-Adyr gives fruit every other year. In the off years she says the tree is "thinking".
